insight: Founder John Glasgow earlier built Invoice2go (acquired by Bill.com); Campfire raised a $65M Series B in 2025, ~$100M total.
name: Campfire
tagline: AI-first ERP for modern finance and accounting teams.
description: Campfire is an AI-native ERP that replaces legacy systems like NetSuite, unifying the general ledger, revenue automation and month-end close on one platform. Embedded AI agents draft journal entries, reconcile accounts and answer finance questions in natural language. Founded in 2023, it serves high-growth companies including Replit, PostHog and Decagon.

modelSupport.notes: Embedded AI agents for journal entries, reconciliation and a natural-language finance assistant.

edge: A full AI-native ERP replacement (GL, revenue, close) — not a bolt-on AI feature on legacy software — built for startups migrating off NetSuite.
pros: Full ERP, not a point tool
cons: Aimed at finance teams, not SMBs

references.title: Tiny AI ERP startup Campfire is winning startups from NetSuite
